We break things to understand them, then build something better. And when we see a problem, we own it. If that sounds like you, let’s talk. The Role As a QA Software Engineer, you’ll be part of the core team building Dawnguard’s platform. Your focus will be on designing and executing comprehensive testing strategies across front-end and back-end systems to ensure our platform meets both functional and non-functional requirements. You’ll collaborate with founding engineers, product designers, and security experts to: Build integration tests for front-end and back-end components using modern testing frameworks. Execute functional and non-functional tests, including stress testing and chaos engineering. Generate detailed test reports for the CTO and leadership team. Support developers in writing and maintaining unit tests. Responsibilities Design and implement a full-stack testing program across the platform. Report on system testability and test outcomes. Collaborate with the Head of Product Design to ensure systems meet user expectations. Validate performance, scalability, and security across services. Contribute to front-end development tasks when needed. Qualifications 3+ years of experience in test engineering or software engineering, ideally within cloud or cybersecurity domains. Proficiency in test development using frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, etc. Solid understanding of front-end technologies (TypeScript, Angular). Bonus: Experience with Storybook for component testing and documentation. What You’ll Get Competitive salary and equity package. Flexible working hours and remote setup. Unlimited PTO Opportunity to shape a category-defining product from the ground up. For any questions or additional information, feel free to contact us at careers@dawnguard.ai . Dawnguard does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from external recruiters. Any such materials received will not create an obligation to pay referral fees.

review_candidates.title: Data Engineer - Oracle, MySQL, OLTP
review_candidates.description: R219538 Job Profile Position Overview At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Data Engineer within PNC's Lending Tech organization, you will be based in Miamisburg, OH, or Pittsburgh, PA, or Dallas, TX, or Birmingham, AL, or Strongsville, OH. We are building and operating an enterprise-scale, high-volume transactional database that supports all lending payment transactions end-to-end. This role designs, builds, and maintains highly available, performant, and secure data stores and data movement patterns across MySQL and Oracle platforms, partnering closely with application engineering, SRE/operations, and security teams. You will be accountable for database architecture and implementation decisions that directly impact transaction integrity, latency, resiliency, and operational excellence. What You’ll Do (core Responsibilities) Architecture & Design Design and evolve an enterprise transactional data model for lending payment processing (OLTP), including schemas, constraints, indexing strategies, partitioning, and retention/archival patterns. Define database standards for reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency across MySQL and Oracle. Build & Operate (Production Ownership) Implement and operate high availability and disaster recovery patterns; validate operational readiness (failover/failback, replication health, recovery objectives). Drive performance engineering: query tuning, index strategy, execution plan analysis, contention/locking analysis, and workload management. Implement automation for database operations (provisioning support, patch readiness support, backup validation, health checks, and runbook-driven execution). Data Movement & Replication Design and support replication/data movement strategies as needed for resiliency and/or cross-site requirements (preferred Oracle skills include Golden Gate and Data Guard). Security & Compliance Partner with security to enforce encryption-in-transit/at-rest, least privilege, auditing, secrets management integration, and vulnerability remediation for database platforms. Cross-team Collaboration Work closely with application teams on schema evolution, release coordination, and safe migration approaches (including MySQL ↔ Oracle considerations). Produce durable documentation: architecture diagrams, decision records, runbooks, and operational validation checklists. Required Qualifications Strong hands-on experience designing and operating high-volume, enterprise OLTP databases supporting mission-critical transactions. Advanced SQL and performance tuning experience across MySQL and Oracle (query tuning, indexing, partitioning, execution plan analysis). Experience with operational best practices: backup/restore validation, patch planning, monitoring/alerting, incident response, and runbooks. Proven ability to collaborate across engineering, operations, and security with clear, structured communication. Preferred Qualifications (Oracle Focus) Oracle Exadata experience (engineering/tuning/operations on Exadata platforms). Oracle Data Guard experience (HA/DR, role transitions, validation of primary/standby states). Oracle Golden Gate experience (replication design/operations). Understanding of enterprise MySQL deployment/replication patterns (e.g., primary/replica cross-site patterns). Owns significant components of the database platform (specific schemas/domains, key performance areas, or HA/DR operational ownership) with minimal guidance. Responsible for technical workstreams (e.g., partitioning rollout, performance remediation, operational readiness) and drives them to closure. Improves runbooks/automation; contributes to production incident response and prevention. Owns end-to-end database architecture for the platform or a major program (e.g., enterprise transaction store modernization, MySQL→Oracle strategy, multi-site replication/DR patterns). Sets standards and is an escalation point for complex performance and replication/DR tradeoffs. Mentors engineers/DBAs, drives cross-team alignment, and influences roadmap decisions with measurable operational outcomes (availability, latency, stability). Establishes and enforces engineering rigor: design reviews, operational readiness gates, and evidence-based performance validation. What success looks like (first 6–12 months) Improved database performance and stability through measurable tuning and operational guardrails (reduced latency, fewer recurring incidents). Clear HA/DR posture with validated runbooks and repeatable failover readiness checks. Documented, scalable schema/partitioning/retention strategy for payment transactions that supports volume growth sustainably. Education BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals. PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position. Job Description Develops, supports and implements data services for multiple applications to meet business objectives and user requirements. Uses technical knowledge and industry experience to design, build and maintain technology solutions. Works closely with users, developers, operations and business partners to define data service requirements and the data preparation process development. Designs and builds data service infrastructure on multiple data platforms, according to key business processes and the overall workflow. Develops and implements data solutions for multiple applications to ensure its scalability, availability and maintainability. Implements data migration and transformation activities/processes to ensure the accuracy and security of data solutions. PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be: Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions. Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework. Qualifications Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position. Preferred Skills Analytical Thinking, Competitive Advantages, Data Analytics, Data Mining, Data Science, Machine Learning (ML), MySQL, Online Transaction Processing (OLTP), Oracle Competencies Application Delivery Process, Big Data Management and Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analysis - Software, Data Architecture, Database Structures, Effective Communications, Problem Solving, Software Development Life Cycle Work Experience Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 3+ years of relevant / direct industry experience. Certifications are often desired. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered. Education Bachelors Certifications No Required Certification(s) Licenses No Required License(s) Pay Transparency Base Salary: $42,000.00 – $172,250.00 Salaries may vary based on geographic location, market data and on individual skills, experience, and education. This role is incentive eligible with the payment based upon company, business and/or individual performance. Application Window Generally, this opening is expected to be posted for two business days from 04/22/2026, although it may be longer with business discretion. Benefits PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives. In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service. To learn more about these and other programs, including benefits for full time and part-time employees, visit pncthrive.com. Disability Accommodations Statement If an accommodation is required to participate in the application process, please contact us via email at AccommodationRequest@pnc.com. Please include “accommodation request” in the subject line title and be sure to include your name, the job ID, and your preferred method of contact in the body of the email. Emails not related to accommodation requests will not receive responses. Applicants may also call 877-968-7762 and say "Workday" for accommodation assistance. All information provided will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. At PNC we foster an inclusive and accessible workplace. We provide reasonable accommodations to employment applicants and qualified individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of their positions. Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) PNC provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other categories protected by law. This position is subject to the requirements of Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDIA) and, for any registered role, the Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage Licensing Act of 2008 (SAFE Act) and/or the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), which prohibit the hiring of individuals with certain criminal history. California Residents Refer to the California Consumer Privacy Act Privacy Notice to gain understanding of how PNC may use or disclose your personal information in our hiring practices.

review_candidates.title: Pre-Sales Engineer (French speaker)
review_candidates.description: SOVOS Pre-Sales Engineer (French Speaker) Sales Engineering·Full-Time·United Kingdom Build Your Future With Us The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions. We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to manage increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive. AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change. Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here. The Role At Sovos, we're transforming how businesses manage complex global compliance. This Pre-Sales Engineer role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical advisory, supporting multi-country sales engagements across our tax and compliance technology portfolio. You'll act as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers, leading discovery, designing scalable solutions, and positioning the business value of our platform. More Specifically, You Will Lead complex, multi-entity discovery sessions across global customer organisations, mapping transaction flows, ERP landscapes, and regulatory exposure. Design scalable, cross-border solution architectures aligned to business and compliance needs, positioning commercial value alongside technical functionality. Influence technical and business stakeholders, including senior decision-makers, and partner with Sales to shape account strategy and advance deals through structured qualification. Own technical responses for enterprise RFPs, RFIs and global tenders, and deliver tailored demonstrations reflecting global regulatory and ERP scenarios. Operate as a trusted advisor in partner-led and embedded solution models, collaborating cross-functionally to ensure seamless transition from pre-sales to implementation. Contribute to global pre-sales best practices, messaging, and competitive positioning, and maintain high-quality demo environments aligned with market requirements. Leverage AI tools to improve discovery workflows, automate response generation, and enhance demonstration personalisation. What You Bring to Sovos You can lead structured discovery sessions, design scalable solutions, and confidently influence enterprise buying decisions You're skilled at leading structured discovery and solution mapping conversations, with a commercial mindset and the ability to influence customer buying decisions. Experience navigating ERP ecosystems is highly desirable; exposure to tax, compliance, regulatory, finance or adjacent domains is advantageous. You're comfortable operating autonomously with appropriate support with limited regional infrastructure, working effectively across time zones and global teams. You have strong written and verbal communication skills in English and French, and you're willing to travel occasionally. Comfort with AI-assisted workflows and tools that enhance pre-sales efficiency and personalisation is a plus. Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire. The Process We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect: 1 Pre-Employment Assessment Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot. 2 Video Interview A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume. 3 Meeting with a Recruiter A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals. 4 Live Interviews with the Hiring Team Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role. Life at Sovos The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside! Global Mentoring Programs AI Tools and Technology from Day 1 Continuous Learning and Development Language Learning Support Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs Global Parental Leave Policy 30 days holiday plus bank holidays Private Health Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Coverage Life Insurance Critical Illness Cover Income Protection Pension with employer contribution Employee Assistance Programme Equal Opportunity Employer Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to contribute authentically and be valued for their unique perspectives and backgrounds. Company Background Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries. More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com. Ready to make your move? We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application SOVOS © Sovos 2026. All rights reserved.
